thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] P1 - high error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 - paging olivia (oncall) and mike_sre. Symptoms: KV cache memory spike + continuous-batching queue growth. Incident INC-2026-0452
olivia (oncall): ack, I'm on it. moving discussion here. anyone see recent deploys or config rollouts?
mike_sre: I'm here. dashboards show kvcache evictions spiking and batching backlog increasing around 10:20 UTC. RPS looks steady.
tara_eng: adding context - we started a speculative decoding rollout (spec_decode=v2) at ~10:12 UTC to 10% traffic.
jin_ml: speculative decoding touches draft/target token flow. If speculative drafts get persisted and later fallback, we can get KV inconsistency. we had a PR last week touching KV write gating.
olivia (oncall): timeline + logs pls.
mike_sre: paste logs:
```
[10:21:05] kvcache: write_set size=3.2M entries, mem=56GB
[10:21:06] batching: queue_len=2400, avg_wait_ms=420
[10:21:07] model: speculative_decode: accepted draft_id=0x7f3a...
[10:21:08] error: kvcache: write failed: OOM
```
olivia (oncall): ok so mem blowup -> OOMs -> retries -> batching backlog -> perf cliff. initial mitigations: disable speculative decode rollout, reduce batch window, and shed cache memory.
tara_eng: +1. can we flip a feature flag quickly?
mike_sre: yes. runtime feature flags exist. command to kill-switch spec_decode in prod us-west-2:
```
redwoodctl config set runtime.speculative_decode.enabled false --env prod --region us-west-2
```
propagation ~30s.
jin_ml: disabling stops new divergence but doesn't fix already persisted inconsistent entries; those need reconciliation or eviction.
olivia (oncall): plan: 1) disable spec_decode in us-west-2, 2) reduce batching.max_window to 10ms, 3) lower kvcache eviction threshold to aggressively free memory, 4) notify customers.
support_lead: customer-impact: seeing elevated 5xx for several accounts in prod-us-west-2. CS engaged with customers A & B.
mike_sre: applying flag now.
[deploy-bot]: config change applied to 23/24 serving nodes in us-west-2 (propagating)
mike_sre: reducing batching window param now:
```
redwoodctl runtime update --region us-west-2 --set batching.max_window_ms=10
```
tara_eng: also pushing kvcache eviction hotfix: change eviction_threshold 0.85 -> 0.6.
jin_ml: note we may see transient hit-rate drop and small latency spike after eviction.
olivia (oncall): monitoring dashboards please.
mike_sre: propagation looks good. error rate trending down 6% -> 1.8% in 3 minutes.
[monitoring-bot]: kvcache node CPU down 93% -> 65%; batch queue_len 2400 -> 120
support_lead: customers A/B report partial recovery; some 503s persist.
tara_eng: we should scan for stale/inconsistent cache entries with mismatched draft_id/target_id. I'll run a query.
jin_ml: sample query to find divergence:
```
SELECT key, draft_id, target_id FROM kv_entries WHERE draft_id IS NOT NULL AND draft_id != target_id LIMIT 100;
```
mike_sre: ran it — found ~12k inconsistent keys, many with large payloads.
olivia (oncall): do we need a full purge? risk?
tara_eng: don't purge blindly. plan: targeted reconciliation job that marks inconsistent keys and reconciles to canonical target_id, avoid deletions. will also prevent new speculative writes until reconcile finishes.
tara_eng: enqueueing reconcile job:
`jobs/reconcile_kv_spec_divergence --region us-west-2 --batch-size 500`
[jobs-bot]: reconcile job enqueued (5000 total, est 10 min)
olivia (oncall): any risk of double-serving or data loss from reconcile?
tara_eng: reconcile prefers target_id and does metadata sync; deletes not part of initial pass. low risk.
mike_sre: tailing metrics: 5xx -> 0.6%, batch queue -> 30, kvcache mem 60GB -> 48GB.
support_lead: CS confirms customers A/B seeing service restored enough to keep tickets open for monitoring.
olivia (oncall): preliminary root cause: interaction between speculative decoding rollout + last week's KV write-path change that allowed speculative drafts to be persisted. combo led to write storms and cache blowup when rollbacks/fallbacks triggered retries.
jin_ml: exact mechanism: speculative decode wrote transient draft entries to cache; fallback paths triggered additional writes/dup entries; duplication + large payloads caused mem amplification.
tara_eng: action items: - revert PR that allowed persistent speculative writes (PR #4321) - add guard to prevent persisting speculative drafts unless validated - add metric for draft/target mismatch ratio - update rollout checklist to include KV sync smoke test
mike_sre: also add automated mitigation: if kvcache_mem>80% then auto-disable speculative decoding and reduce batching window. I'll open infra ticket.
olivia (oncall): handoff: tara_eng lead for postmortem, jin_ml ML reviewer, mike_sre infra owner. I'll close pager in 30m if stable.
support_lead: drafting customer comms: "Intermittent 5xx errors caused by cache write storm related to a speculative decoding rollout. Mitigations applied; reconciliation ongoing."
[ops-bot]: incident INC-2026-0452 marked active -> mitigated at 10:46 UTC by olivia (oncall)
olivia (oncall): last check: error rate 0.2%, recon job 80% complete, memory stable. closing active paging but leaving monitoring on.
mike_sre: saving logs/artifacts to /incidents/INC-2026-0452/artifacts
tara_eng: opening PR to revert write-on-speculative behavior -> https://repo/PR/4339
jin_ml: will run targeted regression evals for speculative decode once PR reverted.
olivia (oncall): thanks all. postmortem ticket created PM-INC-2026-0452. assigning owners. :thumbsup: 
support_lead: will update customers after reconciliation completes.
[archive-bot]: thread scheduled for archive after 1h inactivity
End."
